title: Retired and continued carrier profile IDs (aliases/ids.json)
description: Rule round 45, item 1. A carrier profile's ID is assigned once and kept; it is not recomputed from its match set. The registry is carriers/open plus the retired IDs here. A retired ID is never reused; its entry names the profile or profiles a SIM of its old rule matches now, computed by tools/profile_ids.py, never mapped by hand, and it is a redirect for links and saved reports that never carries a value. continued lists live IDs whose match set is no longer the one they were issued for. tools/profile_ids.py check and tools/validate_public_carrier_data.py check what a schema cannot: targets in the registry, hashes of the stated match sets, entries only ever added.

kind.description: replaced: one new profile took its SIMs; split: several new profiles took them; merge: one new profile took the SIMs of several retired IDs; withdrawn: no new profile took them.

to.description: The profiles a SIM of the old rule provably matches in the data the ID was retired in: the most specific covering profiles and every profile that takes part of its SIMs. Sorted. Each is live or itself aliased.

match.description: The retired match set, as it was published.

match_set_hash.description: The canonical match-set hash of match.

basis.description: same_sims: the resolver proved the new match set covers exactly the same SIMs (order, case or duplicates differ); continuity_entry: a continuity entry the resolver computed and a reviewer accepted.

match_set_hash.description: The hash of the ID's current match set.

from_match_set_hash.description: The hash of the match set it carried over from.
